uiCopy.label: X Axis
uiCopy.tooltip: Controls the horizontal axis. Typically mapped to pan, mix, or any left-right parameter.
uiCopy.do: Use for spatial positioning, stereo control, or morphing between two states
uiCopy.dont: Map to parameters requiring binary on/off control

uiCopy.label: Y Axis
uiCopy.tooltip: Controls the vertical axis. Typically mapped to filters, volume, or up-down parameters.
uiCopy.do: Perfect for filter sweeps, brightness control, and intensity
uiCopy.dont: Use for fine-grained frequency selection—too broad for precision

uiCopy.label: Z Axis
uiCopy.oneLiner: Depth control via scroll or pinch gesture (0% = back, 100% = front)
uiCopy.tooltip: Controls depth/dimension. Use mouse wheel, touch pinch, or trackpad scroll.
uiCopy.do: Map to reverb, delay, or any depth/distance parameter
uiCopy.dont: Forget to use scroll/pinch—Z won't respond to simple cursor movement

uiCopy.label: Speed
uiCopy.oneLiner: How fast you're moving (0% = stopped, 100% = maximum velocity)
uiCopy.tooltip: Outputs velocity of your movement. Faster = higher values.
uiCopy.do: Use for dynamic expression—moving creates more effect
uiCopy.dont: Expect values when not moving—speed is 0% at rest

uiCopy.label: Acceleration
uiCopy.oneLiner: Change in speed (-100% = slowing, +100% = speeding up)
uiCopy.tooltip: Detects gesture acceleration/deceleration. Spikes at start/stop.
uiCopy.do: Perfect for accent detection and capturing performance intention
uiCopy.dont: Use for continuous modulation—this is event-based

modes.name: Absolute Mode
modes.description: Position directly maps to output values
modes.behavior: Cursor position = output value. Bottom-left = 0%, top-right = 100%.

modes.name: Relative Mode
modes.behavior: Moving changes value; releasing holds position. No snapping.
